title: Bolder hand, round 2
question: Round 2, led by the Follow-up Feed. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Follow-up Feed
options.thesis: Today's follow-ups play as a feed: one investor fills the screen, actions stacked on the right, the next one a single snap away.
options.viewport: The first overdue investor fills the work area in their stage colour; name and last note low-left; Done, Snooze, Email, WhatsApp stacked right; the next investor peeks below.
options.risk: Great for working the queue; analytics pages must stay normal tables or it becomes a toy.

raised.raise: Destructive actions (mark do-not-contact) sit apart from the others with deliberate empty space.
Time in stage is drawn at exact length, so a stalled investor visibly drags.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: A visible construction grid holds the whole app; the week's number is built monumental from its cells.
options.viewport: A monumental cell-built 312 on the grid with the red accent plane marking the gap to 500; follow-ups snap to the same cells.
options.case: The most distinctive look with clear numbers; the grid has to stay faint behind dense tables.
options.risk: Grid-built digits are slower to read than plain figures, so plain figures sit beside them.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: The hashmap drawn as one barcode of 21,486 bars; pure black and white, with inversion as the only state.
options.viewport: A full-width barcode of every email across the top; tabular KPIs below; overdue follow-ups inverted to white on black.
options.case: Unforgettable signature for the hashmap; giving up colour makes bounced vs overdue harder to tell apart.
options.risk: No colour at all: every state must read through inversion, weight and labels.

options.label: Lexicon
options.thesis: Investors set like dictionary entries; guide words name the range in view; colour lives only inside bordered plates.
options.viewport: Guide words in the head rule, today's follow-ups as entries in a column, the weekly target and hashmap as colour plates beside them, a thumb index down the edge.
options.case: Excellent for the 21k-contact directory; the bookish look is the familiar cream-and-serif look.
options.risk: Can read as a reading app rather than a working tool.

options.label: Dark Console
options.case: Clear, but it is the category default in dark mode.
options.kept: Destructive actions isolated by empty space.

options.label: Dance Score
options.thesis: Time runs upward; block length is exact duration.
options.viewport: A vertical staff of investor timelines.
options.case: Too abstract to read follow-ups from.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS analytics dashboard (Linear / Stripe style), executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar, KPI cards across the top, a chart and a follow-ups table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other dashboard by design.
